summary: Bounded probe did not reach a successful end-to-end run. Five immutable attempts retained; harness/setup assertions failed before a complete vote/sort/open/back/guard lifecycle. Source inspection supports a possible vote-state feedback gap: detail vote arrows render without selected-state attributes, and successful controller actions use the generic message 'Local forum preview updated.' The Upvotes sort is explicitly based on upvote count, not net score; no net-score defect is claimed. Attempt runs used a hand-written runtime stub and therefore do not satisfy actual fixture-runtime isolation.

attempts.failure: Successful topic submission navigated to detail; probe then incorrectly expected index vote control.
Probe helper selected first vote arrow (upvote), while assertion expected downvote.
Harness expected repeated same-persona upvote to remain; actual source toggles vote off.
Probe attempted index sort while still on detail route.
Incorrect sort fixture expectation: seeded Official Bug Forum has two upvotes and correctly precedes synthetic Beta with one.

source_observations.vote_correction_logic: community.mjs vote() removes the same persona from the opposite direction and returns upvotes/downvotes/score/voted; no successful run independently verified full controller lifecycle.
source_observations.sort_semantics: community.mjs Upvotes sort compares votes.length only; no net-score sort defect is asserted.
source_observations.vote_state_feedback_gap: community.mjs detail arrows have direction labels but no aria-pressed or selected-vote state binding; controller.mjs uses generic success feedback. Source-level usability candidate only, not validated as a complete reproduced issue.

boundaries: No repository/source/native/Git edits, no browser, server, network, or external service use. No sixth attempt run.
